acceptance: Each class either works end to end with tests at a non-1 scale factor, or is removed/deprecated with a clear error pointing to the supported path
No official metric is computed from a failed or partial phase
context: 2026-10-04 throughput adversarial review (develop 8ed0c64e1). TPC-H missing methods and TPC-DS missing scale_factor verified directly.
description:
TPC-DS: `tpcds/official_benchmark.py:169-174` and :189-195 build the power and throughput tests without `scale_factor`, so both default to 1.0. At SF=100, dsqgen renders `-SCALE 1` parameters and Throughput@Size uses SF=1. Line 178 extracts power_at_size without checking success, and the power test counts 70% success as success (power_test.py:418), so QphDS can be published with up to 30% of power queries failed.

TPC-H: `benchbox/tpch.py:216` calls `TPCHOfficialBenchmark(self)`, which raises "scale_factor must be a number, got TPCH". Even when built correctly, `core/tpch/official_benchmark.py:148-176` calls run_power_test/run_throughput_test/run_maintenance_test on TPCHBenchmark, which has none of them (verified: hasattr(TPCHBenchmark, "run_throughput_test") is False). The errors are swallowed and QphH is computed without checking power success.

Both are public APIs.
